question: Sujit can do a piece of work in 4 days, and Rakesh can do it in 8 days. If they work together for 2 days, how much of the work will be left?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Work done by Sujit and Rakesh in 1 day = 1/4 + 1/8 = 3/8

Work done in 2 days = 2 × (3/8) = 3/4

Work left = 1 − 3/4 = 1/4

Percentage of work left = 1/4 × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**
